[[File:KHNPB VHS Cover.jpg|thumb|250px|Rental-only VHS Cover]]
(Japanese: '''けっせん! ほのおのポケモンバトル!!''' ''The Big Match! Fire Pokémon Battle!!'') is the second episode in a series of three [[clip show]]s released as OVAs in 2000 called '''Pocket Monsters TV Special: {{tt|Masara Town|Pallet Town}} Arc Recap''', available on rental-only VHS. They chronicled the events of {{aniseries|PTS}} throughout {{Ash}}'s [[Indigo League]] journey. This episode gives a brief recap of Ash's first four Gym battles, and shows select events from ''[[EP026|Pokémon Scent-sation!]]'' to ''[[EP073|Bad To The Bone]]''. Unlike the previous episode, it contains no footage previously exclusive to TV clipshows and doesn't have any [[Who's That Pokémon?|Dare Da?]] eyecatches, instead using brief humorous clips from the episodes to break up segments.
